import sqlite3
import json

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
c = conn.cursor()

# yield_2024
c.execute("""
    SELECT (r.amount / o.amount) * 100 
    FROM revenues r 
    JOIN operating_metrics o ON r.period_end = o.period_end AND r.months = o.months 
    WHERE r.category = 'Transaction revenues' 
      AND o.metric = 'Total payment volume' 
      AND r.period_end = '2024-12-31' 
      AND r.months = 12
""")
yield_2024 = c.fetchone()[0]

# yield_2023
c.execute("""
    SELECT (r.amount / o.amount) * 100 
    FROM revenues r 
    JOIN operating_metrics o ON r.period_end = o.period_end AND r.months = o.months 
    WHERE r.category = 'Transaction revenues' 
      AND o.metric = 'Total payment volume' 
      AND r.period_end = '2023-12-31' 
      AND r.months = 12
""")
yield_2023 = c.fetchone()[0]

# yield_change (bps)
yield_change = (yield_2024 - yield_2023) * 100

# transaction_contribution
c.execute("""
    SELECT 
        (r2024.amount - r2023.amount) / 
        (
            (SELECT sum(amount) FROM revenues WHERE period_end='2024-12-31' AND months=12 AND category IN ('Transaction revenues', 'Revenues from other value added services')) -
            (SELECT sum(amount) FROM revenues WHERE period_end='2023-12-31' AND months=12 AND category IN ('Transaction revenues', 'Revenues from other value added services'))
        ) * 100
    FROM revenues r2024
    JOIN revenues r2023 ON r2024.category = r2023.category 
    WHERE r2024.category = 'Transaction revenues' 
      AND r2024.period_end = '2024-12-31' AND r2024.months = 12
      AND r2023.period_end = '2023-12-31' AND r2023.months = 12
""")
transaction_contribution = c.fetchone()[0]

print(f"yield_2024: {yield_2024}%")
print(f"yield_2023: {yield_2023}%")
print(f"yield_change: {yield_change} bps")
print(f"transaction_contribution: {transaction_contribution}%")
EOF

  AND o.metric = 'Total payment volume'
  AND r.period_end = '2024-12-31'
  AND r.months = 12
"""

q2 = """
SELECT (r.amount / o.amount) * 100
FROM revenues r
JOIN operating_metrics o ON r.period_end = o.period_end AND r.months = o.months
WHERE r.category = 'Transaction revenues'
  AND o.metric = 'Total payment volume'
  AND r.period_end = '2023-12-31'
  AND r.months = 12
"""
print(c.execute(q2).fetchone()[0])

q3 = """
SELECT (
  (SELECT (r.amount / o.amount) * 10000
   FROM revenues r
   JOIN operating_metrics o ON r.period_end = o.period_end AND r.months = o.months
   WHERE r.category = 'Transaction revenues'
     AND o.metric = 'Total payment volume'
     AND r.period_end = '2024-12-31'
     AND r.months = 12)
  -
  (SELECT (r.amount / o.amount) * 10000
   FROM revenues r
   JOIN operating_metrics o ON r.period_end = o.period_end AND r.months = o.months
   WHERE r.category = 'Transaction revenues'
     AND o.metric = 'Total payment volume'
     AND r.period_end = '2023-12-31'
     AND r.months = 12)
)
"""
print(c.execute(q3).fetchone()[0])

q4 = """
SELECT 
  (
    (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category = 'Transaction revenues' AND period_end = '2024-12-31' AND months = 12) -
    (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category = 'Transaction revenues' AND period_end = '2023-12-31' AND months = 12)
  ) / 
  (
    (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category = 'Total net revenues (2)' AND period_end = '2024-12-31' AND months = 12) -
    (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category = 'Total net revenues (2)' AND period_end = '2023-12-31' AND months = 12)
  ) * 100
"""
print(c.execute(q4).fetchone()[0])
